subject: Crescent Labs — operational impact, proposed credit framework & exec sync
messages:
From: Jordan Price <jordan.price@crescentlabs.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@crescentlabs.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Production degradation since 6/13 — urgent escalation

Avery,

We saw a major regression in production starting 2027-06-13 ~21:00 UTC. Our telemetry shows: 5xx error rates spiked to ~6% (baseline ~0.3%), median response latency increased from ~170ms to ~520ms, and overall throughput to our service dipped by ~40% for most peak windows. This is impacting customer-facing features for our core product.

Ticket #CS-9987 was opened with support last night (I attached the logs and screenshots). We need rapid remediation and a clear path to make Crescent Labs whole. At a minimum, we need: 
- immediate timeline for resolution and root cause
- proposed credit for the impacted usage window (we expect commercial relief)
- executive escalation — this is high visibility for us and may require our CFO to get involved if not addressed quickly

Please advise next steps and availability for an exec sync today.

Thanks,
Jordan Price
Head of Engineering
Crescent Labs
[attachment: support_screenshots.zip (logs + screenshots)]

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@crescentlabs.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@crescentlabs.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Production degradation since 6/13 — urgent escalation

Jordan —

I'm very sorry Crescent hit this. Thank you for the clear telemetry and the ticket. I escalated to our incident team and we've prioritized the investigation. Initial update from ops: a model-routing regression combined with a cache eviction pattern caused increased recomputation and higher tail latency during the 21:00–03:00 UTC window.

Immediate actions:
- Ops containment in progress; mitigation steps are rolling now.
- I'll set an executive sync for today to walk through impact and next steps — proposed times below.
- Ben (AE) and Sean (CS) are looped for commercial & remediation commitments.

Provisional approach to credits (we'll finalize after a root cause and usage audit):
- A one-time make-whole credit to offset the impacted usage window
- Operational commitments (detailed postmortem, telemetry dashboard access, weekly checkpoints)

Proposed times for a 30-min exec sync: 14:30 PT / 16:00 PT / 17:30 PT. Please confirm which works and I'll send calendar invite.

Attaching a provisional credit calc and the SLO summary for your contract.

-Avery
Avery Johnson
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[attachment: cxl-credit-calc-20270614.xlsx (provisional)]

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Crescent Labs escalation — proposed credit math & ask for approvals

Team —

Recap: Crescent saw a ~40% throughput drop and elevated 5xx/latency during the 2027-06-13 21:00–03:00 UTC window. They're asking for commercial relief and want an exec call. I drafted a provisional credit approach in the attached worksheet. Key points: 
- Contract reference: Section 5.2 (SLA remedies) — makes credit the primary remedy, with our option for operational commitments.
- Proposed settlement (recommended): $40,000 one-time credit as invoice offset + 20% discounted rate on dedicated capacity for the following 30 days.
- Rationale: credit aligns with estimated impacted token consumption, plus a latency service penalty (per the SLO). The $40k number is conservatively capped vs the raw calc so we preserve margin while addressing customer goodwill and retention risk.

Action items: 
- Ben: please advise if we can approve $40k + 30-day discount from commercial (or indicate counter).
- Sean: ops commitment — can we deliver root cause & postmortem within 72 hours and a remediation timeline (fix, validation, monitoring improvements)? Also confirm who will be the weekly checkpoint lead.
- Legal/finance: I'll route a short amendment + DocuSign once Ben confirms commercial ok (we'll include the credit as invoice adjustment and a short remediation addendum).

Attachment: internal-credit-cheatsheet.pdf (internal only)

Thanks — Avery

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@crescentlabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@crescentlabs.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Resolution proposal and credit offer — next steps

Jordan —

Thanks for the call this morning and for your patience while we completed the audit. To summarize and propose a path forward: 

What happened (summary):
- Root cause: a routing configuration change combined with an aggressive KV cache eviction edge-case that increased recompute and tail latency during the 21:00–03:00 UTC window on 2027-06-13. Our ops team has deployed a fix and validated stable behavior in staging and rolling in prod; we will monitor 24/7 for the next 72 hours.

Commercial remediation offered: 
- One-time credit of $40,000 applied as an invoice offset against your next invoice.
- A 20% discounted rate on your dedicated capacity for 30 days (applied automatically).

Operational commitments: 
- Full postmortem with timeline and remediation steps delivered within 72 hours.
- Dashboard access to the SLO/latency telemetry for your on-call.
- Weekly check-ins for 6 weeks, led by Sean Gallagher (CC'd) to verify stability and any tuning.

Next steps: 
1) If Crescent accepts, please approve so we can issue the credit.
2) We'll send a short amendment via DocuSign to record the credit and the 30-day discount (link below).
3) Sean will share the remediation timeline and schedule the first weekly checkpoint.

DocuSign (amendment): https://docusign.com/link/abcd-1234-crescent-amend

We want to make this right. Please let me know if that commercial package addresses your concerns or if you'd like an alternate structure.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Office: +1 415 555 0123
avery_johnson@redwood.ai
